title: The Last Wreck
author: Xanthe Galloway
blurb: Ada Almeida, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, has spent seven years measuring life in miles rather than years. Then an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must outlast the monsoon with a leaking boat and a stranger's help, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
